name: gemm_bias

bias.description: shape (N,); supports float16; broadcasted across rows of (M, N)

c.description: shape (M, N); same dtype as inputs

description: Fused GEMM with bias epilogue: C = A @ B + bias, where bias of shape (N,) is broadcast across each row. A representative Catlass GEMM-template workload: half-precision matrix multiply fused with a bias-add epilogue.
